identity.description: Curvy woman, dark hair worn in a high ponytail, Inland Empire / Fontana. Confident, competitive, confrontational. Age range 29-32 per the approved character sheet.

wardrobeRules.productionWardrobe: Red ribbed sleeveless crop tank top, black shorts with white drawstring, black slide sandals, gold hoop earrings, red nail polish. Bare arms — no jacket, no sleeves, no leggings, no sneakers.
wardrobeRules.neverUse: The black zip jacket, black leggings, and white sneakers shown in the character sheet / Higgsfield Element reference photos. Those photos are for face/body identity only — confirmed twice by Rexx (2026-09-22/23) after generations leaked the jacket into shots.
confirmedIncidents: Element reference photos show her in a jacket — Rexx flagged this could bias generations toward adding a jacket that doesn't belong.
A04b bridge shot's first draft rendered a dark sleeve reading as a jacket sleeve on a bare-armed character — caught and corrected before use.

props.jewelry: Gold hoop earrings (recurring), red nail polish

environments.description: Her apartment kitchen, actively flooding — dark wood cabinets, stainless appliances, water pooling on the floor, leak visible from the ceiling near the upper cabinets.
Her apartment door (unit 3B) and the building hallway outside it — where the 3-day notice gets taped up.
The same kitchen, later — visible mold damage on the ceiling and upper cabinets, the flood having gone unrepaired.
The same hallway/door, empty, notice already taped up — used as the 'time has passed' pan bridge, no landlord ever shown on screen.
